final_message:
I've written the June 2026 draft for ABC Inc and saved it to `evals/runs/v6-run-20261014/e_abc_dec2025_one_offs/skill_output/`. It contains `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.md` (the report, with my 8 bullets of commentary) and `abc-inc-2026-06-trends.json` (the figures behind it). Every number comes from the analysis script; the commentary only describes what the numbers show and leaves causes and decisions to the reviewer.

**Data quality: all checks pass.** Subtotals, gross profit, operating income, net income and the balance sheet all agree with the workbook in all 18 months (Jan 2025 to Jun 2026). No month is flagged as incomplete, and the script reported no structural warnings.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue:** 195,898, down 6.0% from May 2026 (208,351). May was the highest month in the export, so the drop is from a peak. June is −0.5% against the prior 6-month average and +2.8% against Jun 2025.
- **Profit and cash:** a loss of (330,756), the sixth negative month in a row; the trailing-twelve-month loss is (3,089,780). Cash is 713,481, down 215,543 from May and down 1,871,836 from six months earlier (2,585,317).
- **Dec 2025:** this was the only profitable month, and only because of non-operating items. Without them it was a loss of (715,902), mostly because of a one-month Income Tax Benefit of (1,244,430). Stock-Based Compensation (334,661) and Bonus (80,343) also spike that month. All three are marked for the reviewer to confirm as one-offs.
- **Margin and costs:** gross margin is 70.2%, up 3.1 points on May and down 4.2 points on Jun 2025. Operating expenses excluding non-operating items fell 2.4%. The biggest account changes were Events & Conferences (+17,971) and Bad Debts, which moved from 12,935 to (1,806).
- **Lines at zero:** three small revenue streams (Professional Services, Partnership Income, SKU Profiling) and four expense lines are zero. Each is stated as an observation, and the reviewer decides whether it has stopped or is just timing.

**"Other" category:** one expense account, General Expenses (149 in June), didn't match any category rule and is grouped there.

The output folder name says "dec2025", but you asked for June 2026, and June 2026 is the latest month in the workbook. The report therefore covers June 2026; the December 2025 one-off items are discussed in the commentary.
